description: This file defines the SmsHandler class, which manages sending and searching SMS messages through an SmsManager instance, handling responses and errors, and providing results via GatewaySession.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A handler class for sending and searching SMS messages, managing responses, and error handling.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Sends an SMS message with given parameters and returns the result or error.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Searches for SMS messages with given parameters and returns the result or error.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result with an error message and code.
